# Secret Santa generator: no emails, couples kept apart, organizer plays too

> Free Secret Santa generator with no sign-up and no emails. Keep couples apart, skip last year's pairs, send each person a private link, share wish lists. Runs in your browser.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Ways to hand out the draw

- Group link: one link for the group chat; each person picks their own name (honor system).
- Private links (added 2026-11-23): one link per person, sent by text or DM; each holds only that person's match, so nobody can look up anyone else's.
- Pass the phone: one device, one person at a time.
- Wish list links (added 2026-11-23): after seeing their person, anyone can write a wish list and share a link that holds only their name and ideas.
